turnaround_reason: Gartner de-rated hard in H1 2026 on fears that enterprises will substitute AI assistants for its pricey research/advisory subscriptions, compressing contract value growth to ~1%. The stock is ~17% below its 200d MA but momentum has turned: Q1 2026 adjusted EPS beat by ~11% and shares jumped ~10.7% on the print, with management raising EBITDA/EPS/FCF guidance.
bullish_points: Q1 2026 beat: adjusted EPS $3.32 (+11% vs. estimates, +11.4% YoY); management raised full-year adjusted EPS, EBITDA and FCF guidance
Strong recent momentum: +5.1% 1d, +9.9% 5d, above the 100d MA — the basing pattern is resolving upward into a hard catalyst
High-margin, subscription-based, sticky research franchise with strong free-cash-flow conversion and consistent buybacks
Management explicitly guided that contract value growth 'will accelerate' in H2 2026
Listed options available (nearest expiry 2026-08-21) allow leveraged expression around the Aug 4 catalyst
bearish_points: The AI-substitution bear thesis is structural, not cyclical — if IT departments genuinely eschew third-party research for AI tooling, the moat erodes permanently
Contract value grew only ~1% and revenue slipped ~1.5% in Q1 — the fundamental reacceleration is a promise, not yet a result
Full-year top-line guide was trimmed to below $6.41B even as profitability guidance rose (margin-led, not growth-led, story)
Stock has already rallied into the print, raising the bar and the risk of a 'sell-the-news' fade if CV acceleration doesn't show
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings call on August 4, 2026 — the market wants evidence that contract value is inflecting higher and that AI is a tailwind (Gartner's own research on AI spend) rather than a share threat
suggested_trade: Spot starter position now; consider a small Aug 21 or Sep 18 call position sized as a defined-risk bet on CV acceleration at the Aug 4 print. Keep options small — IV/OI is modest and a fade is plausible after the run-up.
key_risk: Q2 shows contract value still stuck near +1% with no acceleration, validating the AI-disruption bear case and unwinding the post-Q1 momentum
would_skip_if: Contract value fails to accelerate at Q2 or management softens the H2 acceleration guidance; also skip the options leg if the stock keeps ripping into the print (poor risk/reward)
